{{Item description|Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.|A jacket that any messenger would love to wear. 
Scramblers are cheap and effective modes of transport on Talos-II. Messengers would often outfit these bikes with different mods and modules.}}
